questions.question: When Aaron's staff and the Egyptian magicians' staffs all became serpents before Pharaoh, what did Aaron's staff do?

answers.text: Chased them out of the palace

questions.question: Moses told Pharaoh to let the Hebrew people go. What reason did the LORD give?

answers.text: So they could worship Him in the wilderness
So they could build Him a great temple
So they could rest from all their work

questions.question: When Aaron turned the Nile to blood, Egypt's magicians could not do the same with their magic arts. True or false?
After Aaron struck the Nile and turned all its water to blood, what did Pharaoh do?

answers.text: Went into his palace without taking it to heart
Stayed on the riverbank to watch the water
Sent his officials out to clean the Nile
